sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner has drawn our attention to an order dated 02.08.2018 passed by this Court wherein the statement made on behalf of the petitioner has been recorded to the effect he shall not come in the way of completion of the public project, however, his stand taken in the writ petition should not be affected.
Further submission recorded in the said order is that it is the case of the petitioner that he was in actual possession of the land in question and further compensation had also not been tendered.

The Court, accordingly,
vacated the interim order dated 12.04.2017 which was done without prejudice to the rights,
contentions and pleas raised by the petitioner in the writ petition.
3. It has been stated that pursuant to the said order, the DDA took over the actual physical possession of the land in question.

We have been informed by learned counsel representing the DDA that road widening on the spot has also been done, however, the fact remains that the petitioner has not been paid any amount towards compensation.

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel representing the Land Acquisition Collector as the DDA have stated that they are ready to pay the compensation which, according to them is payable to the petitioner.

5. Learned counsel for the petitioner informs that the petitioner is 75 years of age and, accordingly,
having regard to the overall facts and circumstances of the case, we direct that compensation in respect of the subject land shall be paid by the Land Acquisition Collector/ DDA which may be admissible to the petitioner as per the Land Acquisition Collector/ DDA.
The payment of the compensation along with the interest, if any, shall be made to the petitioner within 06 weeks from today.
For the said purpose, the petitioner shall complete the requisite formalities within a fortnight from today.
We make it clear that unnecessary objections in completion of the formalities shall not be raised by the Land Acquisition Collector/ DDA.
We may also observe that payment of compensation under this Order shall be without prejudice to the right of the petitioner as regards the quantum of compensation.
The petitioner is permitted to move an amendment application seeking appropriate amendment of the prayer clause in the light of the subsequent developments This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 15/07/2025 at 21:29:33 within two weeks.

By the next date of hearing, affidavits shall be filed by the Land Acquisition Collector/ DDA giving the details of the amount and the manner of payment of compensation to the petitioner under this Order.
DEVENDRA KUMAR UPADHYAYA, CJ ANISH DAYAL, J JULY 10, 2025 N.Khanna
